name: table-cells
title: Table cells
description: The seven cells every table needs, aligned and truncating correctly: person, date, money, status, progress, tags and actions.
docs: Put each cell inside a TableCell and give it plain values: IdentityCell a name, DateCell a date with a locale and time zone, MoneyCell an amount and a currency. Pass now to DateCell when the text must read the same every time. Give the header of a money or number column text-right, and change where a cell truncates with a max-width class. IdentityCell keeps its avatar at one size with or without a detail line (size sm, default or lg), so a column of people stays straight.
